content: Hello, I'm somewhat new to the Lean community but I have been thinking about a project and I'm wondering if it is a reasonable idea and, if so, whether anyone would like to collaborate on it. I was wondering how one could determine whether Gödel's Loophole exists. To figure it out, I've been thinking about formalizing the institutional structure of the United States Constitution (Congress, Presidency, elections, succession, etc.) and then trying to prove facts about it. For example the main goal would be to prove that, excluding the trivial case that the document can be amended, in this formal model of the Constitution, no sequence of constitutional actions can result in a dictatorship, or find a counterexample. I was wondering how difficult this would be and if anyone is interested in collaborating.
You might want to look at existing attempts at formalizing law, like https://popl23.sigplan.org/details/prolala-2023-papers/2/Formalising-Criminal-Law-in-Catala
